title: 331_120752_Numeric_Files_1944–1945_37153_German_Armament_Equipment_Documents
doc_notes: This document is a collection of military correspondence and reports regarding 'night phenomena' or 'foo fighters' observed by Allied aircrews during 1944-1945, containing specific encounter reports.

encounters.summary: A 107th P.R. Squadron pilot reported a long cylindrical object, 12 feet long and 1 foot in diameter, floating vertically at 9,000 feet. The object had small fins and a mast. It was attacked, partially deflated, and emitted a red flame without smoke.
encounters.quote: An aluminum coloured cylinder shaped object, about 12 feet long and 1 foot in diameter was observed floating in the air
